initialExam.title: SSC GD Constable 2026
initialExam.description: Recruitment for Constable (GD) in BSF, CISF, CRPF, SSB, ITBP, AR, NIA, and SSF. CBT conducted Apr-May 2026; answer key released 15 Jun 2026; result expected July 2026.
initialExam.syllabus: General Intelligence & Reasoning (20Q), General Knowledge & Awareness (20Q), Elementary Mathematics (20Q), English/Hindi (20Q).
initialExam.examPattern: CBT: 80 questions, 160 marks, 60 min. Negative marking: 0.25 marks. Physical: 5 km run, long jump, high jump.
initialExam.selectionProcess: CBT → Physical Efficiency Test (PET) → Physical Standard Test (PST) → Medical → Document Verification
initialExam.jobRole: Constable (GD) in Central Armed Police Forces and SSF
initialExam.careerGrowth: Constable → Head Constable → ASI → SI → Inspector through promotions.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit ssc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Ration Allowance, Uniform Allowance, Medical, Pension
